name: mnemonic_sacrifice_catalyst
label: Memory's Last Stand
poeticVision: The gut-wrenching decision to sacrifice a piece of your very being—a cherished memory, a foundational skill, a forgotten face—hardening it into a desperate projectile. Each shot is a permanent erasure, a fragment of Lyra's soul hurled against the encroaching void, leaving an echo of grief in its wake and a palpable sense of self-diminishment.

parameters.name: projectile_lifetime
parameters.description: Maximum lifetime of the projectile in seconds if it doesn't hit anything.

parameters.name: projectile_shader
parameters.description: ShaderMaterial to apply to the projectile's mesh.

dependencies: memory_projectile.tscn (PackedScene: RigidBody3D with MeshInstance3D and CollisionShape3D)
verdict: A desperate act of self-annihilation transformed into a weapon, each memory hurled a poignant echo of Lyra's fading soul against the encroaching void.
impact: This invention transforms combat from a mere skill challenge into a profound existential dilemma. Players will face gut-wrenching decisions, sacrificing cherished fragments of Lyra's identity to survive immediate threats. Every projectile fired will carry the weight of permanent loss, deepening the player's emotional connection to Lyra's struggle against self-dissolution and making each encounter an unforgettable, grief-laden strategic choice.
